video.acting_natural.evidence: [Riley·claude] Muted, the shot reads like this: a woman follows a man leading a mule into a stone city gate. A workman by the right-hand wall lifts a basket onto his shoulder, sees her and nods. She walks into the dark tunnel, turns to the camera, sweeps a hand toward the pale cracks on the left wall while talking, then turns and walks toward the bright exit. That matches the shot's point ("they're still patching the cracks"), though in the 4fps sheet the worker carries the basket and is never seen smearing mortar into a crack. Riley beat by beat: 0–3.75s she walks away from camera with her weight shifting and arms swinging (cells 0.000–3.750). She does not wave at anyone or turn back. 4.0–4.5s, as she draws level with the worker on her right, her right hand rises briefly to brow height for the greeting (cells 4.000/4.250/4.500), then drops. It lasts about 0.75s and is not exaggerated. The worker is looking at her at the same moment (4.000–4.750) and turns away right after, so the cause and effect are timely. 5.0–7.0s she enters the arch and slows, without any extra moves. 7.25–7.75s she turns toward the camera. 9.0–10.25s, still facing camera, she reaches her right hand (frame left) toward the white mortar scars on the left arch wall and lowers it at 10.5. That is about 1.2s, one gesture, done once. It lands roughly 1.4s after the line "See all these cracks?" starts at 7.6s, which is within tolerance. 10.5–16.25s she talks with her body three-quarter turned and her head looking over her shoulder at the camera, hands down. Her head angle varies a little from cell to cell, so she is not a frozen prop. The bit is not dragged out or repeated, and there is no extra theatrical move. 16.5–17.75s she turns back and walks toward the light, with natural walking. Throughout she only reacts to the worker and the camera and never interacts with the porter, which fits someone just passing through. Note: the faces are too small in the sheet to confirm the grin, the eyebrow raise and the closing wink. This finding rests on what her body and arms are doing.

video.point_landed.evidence: [director·codex] 关声音看到的是：Riley走近城门，与搬筐工人招呼，进入门洞后转身、指向墙上的浅色补痕，再继续前行。图1的6–16秒能看到明显补痕，但0–5.75秒工人呈现的是提筐、持筐和离开，没有往裂缝里抹灰浆的可见动作。对照看点中“一个工人正往裂缝里抹灰浆”，持续修补的核心画面未落地。
